description: Blast radius of a change: transitive callers/subtypes of the target plus files reachable through imports, with affected TEST files highlighted. Target a symbol (symbol_id/path+line/name), a set of files (files=[...]), or nothing — no arguments analyzes the uncommitted git diff.

cursor.description: continuation token from a truncated response; repeat the same arguments with it

max_tokens.description: soft cap on response size in estimated tokens; truncated output says how to get the rest

min_confidence.description: ignore call edges below this confidence

path.description: with line: innermost symbol at that position

name: change_impact
title: Change impact
